Voxelization - Open3D 0.19.0 documentation
Voxelization # Point clouds and triangle meshes are very flexible, but irregular, geometry types. The voxel grid is another geometry type in 3D that is defined on a regular 3D grid, whereas a voxel can be thought of as the 3D counterpart to the pixel in 2D.
